## Session Context (KiCad MCP)

You have access to KiCad PCB/schematic design automation tools (41 MCP tools across 6 categories):
- PCB tools: info, DRC, export (Gerber/STEP/PDF/SVG), place components, add tracks/vias
- Schematic: info, ERC, export (netlist/PDF/SVG)
- Library: search footprints and symbols
- Marketplace: search and download from GitHub/SnapEDA/kitspace

**Before starting work:**
1. Check KiCad status: kicad_status()
2. List available commands: kicad_supported_commands()

**At end of work:**
- Review PCB/design exports and save outputs
- Save work to outputs directory via pcb_save/sch_export_*
